title: Proper surjections lift prescribed geometric specializations
statement:
Let $p:T\to S$ be a proper surjective morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism]. Let $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_s\to S$ and $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_t\to S$ be geometric points [def-weil-geometric-point], and let $c:\bar t\Rightarrow\bar s$ be a $2$-morphism between their associated points of the small etale topos [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-trf-geometric-morphism], in the direct-image convention of [lem-trf-oriented-product-universal]. Thus $c$ is a prescribed geometric specialization, not just a relation between the underlying Zariski points. There exist algebraically closed field extensions $\Omega_s\hookrightarrow\Omega'_s$, $\Omega_t\hookrightarrow\Omega'_t$, with induced maps $r_s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega'_s\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_s$ and $r_t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega'_t\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_t$, geometric points $\bar s':\operatorname{Spec}\Omega'_s\to T$ and $\bar t':\operatorname{Spec}\Omega'_t\to T$, and a specialization $c':\bar t'\Rightarrow\bar s'$ on $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$, such that
$$p\bar s'=\bar s r_s,\qquad p\bar t'=\bar t r_t.$$
Under the canonical isomorphisms of stalk functors furnished by these field extensions [lem-weil-pbc-geometric-point-morphism-stalk-bijection], the image $p c'$ is exactly $c$. All points, field extensions and topoi are taken in a common enlarged universe [def-weil-size-convention].

source.place: Proof of Lemma 9.1.5, printed p. 21, assertion that every point lifts. Scheme-theoretic ingredients: literature/stacks-project/schemes.tex, Tag 01KE (lemma-lift-specializations-valuative), and literature/stacks-project/etale-cohomology.tex, Tag 0GJ5 (remark-can-lift). The prescribed specialization is retained by first passing to the strict localization at the target geometric point.
